title: Inactive global menu-source discovery registry
research_scope: Real menus, dated institutional meal plans, menu-item observations and historical menu records. Separate recipe, food-product, venue and image-benchmark classes.

execution_policy.required_user_gate: All eight databases must be provisioned and relationally fit for existing data before any production fetch on Foo.
execution_policy.actions_taken: Read-only catalog/documentation research and minimal web sample attempts only. No production fetch, bulk archive download, active fetch configuration, database mutation, or Git publication.

tier_definitions.A: Explicit content/data reuse permission evidenced by official catalog or research repository; still disabled and subject to source-specific verification gates. A does not mean every resource schema or upstream chain is resolved.
tier_definitions.B: Useful lead but license scope, original availability, authenticated access, or item-level rights unresolved. Not ready for production.
tier_definitions.C: Restricted/noncommercial/commercial-contract/synthetic/image-only lead; not a ready reusable real-menu corpus.

counts_policy: Counts preserve publisher date, unit and subset. Never add overlapping sources, physical/digitized/transcribed counts, documents/pages/items, rolling snapshots, or unique labels as if equivalent menus.

requirements: Preserve original Unicode text and language; translation is a separate derived layer.
Menu item/dish name or ingredient composition alone is not a recipe.
Preserve dates, timezone, calendar system, original currency and source publication dates.
Distinguish scheduled offer from verified service and historical observation from current availability.
Never map out_of_stock to live stock claims in this discovery stream.
Keep nutrition basis and scope (meal, item, serving, 100 g) rather than attaching meal totals to every dish.
Allergen/diet claims are source assertions, not safety guarantees; keep trace ambiguity.
Missing versus zero price/quantity remains distinct.
Same dish offered on multiple dates is multiple observations; derived mirrors do not add independent coverage.
Generic institutional diets are permitted scope; identifiable patient/resident medical data is excluded.
